content.short: .box is the world's first and only ICANN-accredited ENS domain.
content.description: Web2 domains carry security risks, outdated ownership models, and slow transfer times. Web3 domains often cannot natively resolve websites, be configured for email, or be indexed by major search engines. By contrast, .box domains give you true ownership and custody of tokenized domains, enabling instant transfers. .box websites resolve across all browsers, support email, and can be indexed by search engines, offering stronger control, security, and discoverability for your digital identity.
content.meta: .box offers ICANN-accredited ENS domains for onchain identity and naming. Discover .box and other Identity Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
